$comment: Reviewed experimental Node-only canvas contract. This is a schema input, not a released CLI version or runtime capability assertion.

executable.description: Executable used to launch the extension entrypoint.

args.description: Opaque integrator-defined arguments passed to the executable. The runtime does not append the extension entrypoint.

env.description: Opaque integrator-defined environment variables. Runtime-owned COPILOT_SDK_PATH, SESSION_ID, and COPILOT_EXTENSION_PARENT_PID values take precedence.

value.description: Opaque integrator-owned process launch profile for one extension entrypoint.
value.title: ExtensionLaunchProfile

contractVersion.description: Supported extension launch-provider contract version. Clients requiring this contract must check for version 1 before creating or resuming sessions.

value.description: Authoritative capability acknowledgement for the registered extension launch provider.
value.title: ExtensionLaunchProviderRegistrationResult

modulePath.description: Absolute path to the discovered extension entrypoint.

source.description: Discovery source for the extension entrypoint.

sessionId.description: Owning runtime session identifier, when known.

defaultLaunch.description: Runtime-computed built-in launch profile, not yet executed. Contains only bootstrap environment overrides, never the inherited process environment. Return unchanged to approve this candidate. Omitted when this embedding has no built-in launcher; no private bootstrap paths should be fabricated by the client.

value.description: A discovered extension entrypoint that the registered integrator may classify and resolve to an opaque launch profile.
value.title: ExtensionLaunchProviderResolveRequest

anyOf.description: Opaque integrator-owned process launch profile for one extension entrypoint.

launch.description: Approved launch profile, or absent/null to deny this candidate without fallback.

value.description: The approved launch profile. An absent or null launch denies execution; the runtime never falls back to its built-in launcher.
value.title: ExtensionLaunchProviderResolveResult

value.description: Discovery source: project (.github/extensions/), user (~/.copilot/extensions/), plugin (installed plugin), or session (session-state/<id>/extensions/)
value.title: ExtensionSource

x-enumDescriptions.project: Extension discovered from the current project's .github/extensions directory.
x-enumDescriptions.user: Extension discovered from the user's ~/.copilot/extensions directory.
x-enumDescriptions.plugin: Extension contributed by an installed plugin.
x-enumDescriptions.session: Extension discovered from the current session's state directory (loaded only for this session).

value.description: Registers the calling SDK client as the authoritative per-entrypoint extension launch provider and returns the supported contract version. Call before creating any sessions. Contract version 1 supplies sessionId and defaultLaunch when available; absent or null launch, provider errors, timeouts, and shutdown cancellation never fall back. Without a registered provider, legacy launching is unchanged.

result.description: Authoritative capability acknowledgement for the registered extension launch provider.

value.description: Asks the registered SDK client to approve a launch profile immediately before every extension launch or reload. Return defaultLaunch unchanged to approve the runtime's built-in launcher, or return another profile. An absent or null launch denies execution with no fallback. The provider must respond within 15 seconds. Approval does not sandbox code or freeze mutable files; the host is responsible for approved package contents.

params.description: A discovered extension entrypoint that the registered integrator may classify and resolve to an opaque launch profile.

result.description: The approved launch profile. An absent or null launch denies execution; the runtime never falls back to its built-in launcher.

value.description: Records explicit persistence intent for a local session and flushes its pending state before returning, even without a user or assistant turn. Await this before an admitted potentially effectful canvas open or other non-chat operation. Retention survives stop and cold resume, is idempotent, and is never rolled back on later operation failure or cancellation. Does not run a prompt, grant permissions, or prevent explicit session deletion. Unsupported for remote sessions.
Explicit host intent to persist this local session independently of conversation turns. Emitted by session.retain before a potentially effectful non-chat operation; not a user or assistant message.
value.title: RetainedData

id.description: Unique event identifier (UUID v4), generated when the event is emitted

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the event was created

parentId.description: ID of the chronologically preceding event in the session, forming a linked chain. Null for the first event.

ephemeral.description: When true, the event is transient and not persisted to the session event log on disk

agentId.description: Sub-agent instance identifier. Absent for events from the root/main agent and session-level events.

data.description: Explicit host intent to persist this local session independently of conversation turns. Emitted by session.retain before a potentially effectful non-chat operation; not a user or assistant message.

value.description: Session event "session.retained". Explicit host intent to persist this local session independently of conversation turns. Emitted by session.retain before a potentially effectful non-chat operation; not a user or assistant message.
value.title: RetainedEvent

value.description: Session event "session.retained". Explicit host intent to persist this local session independently of conversation turns. Emitted by session.retain before a potentially effectful non-chat operation; not a user or assistant message.
